title: tTIS_sw_reconstruction: figures and tables of "Transcranial temporal interference stimulation increases slow waves during human NREM sleep", reproduced from summarized source data
description: Drawing scripts, layouts and summarized source data that re-render the main data figures (Figures 3–6) and Table 1 of the paper. Raw and unprocessed data, and the analysis pipeline that summarized them, are available from the corresponding author on reasonable request.
